name: Repeated change of consignee or buyer in transit
description: Shipments or cargoes are re-routed, re-invoiced or have ownership shifted through successive parties without clear commercial reason.
fp: Commodity trading legitimately involves resale in transit.

links.name: Use of multiple intermediaries or repeated changes of consignee
links.ctx: Shipments are re-routed or re-invoiced through successive parties.

links.name: Repeated changes of buyer or consignee mid-voyage
links.ctx: Cargo ownership shifts while at sea without clear commercial reason.
